tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: List the sites on this UserProof account (id, domain, created date). Free.

tools.name: select_site
tools.description: Choose which UserProof site this project uses. With a site_id or domain it is validated against your account and returned so it can be saved to .userproof; with no argument it lists the sites. Free.

tools.name: get_top_fix
tools.description: The single highest-impact fix on this site, with the sessions that prove it and the dollar math when a conversion event is set. Analyses are unlimited; plans are priced on recorded visits. If the result has a notice (visit limit near or passed), tell the user in one line and show any upgrade link on its own line. Free keeps 7 days of recordings: if the user asks about anything older or longer trends, tell them Pro and Scale keep 90 days and offer the upgrade tool. When no finding passes the evidence bar the result ends with a funnel read (biggest visible leak, entry pages, sources, coverage): present it as a lead, not proof, and never as a verified fix.

domain.description: Read this site instead of the active one, e.g. example.com

site_id.description: Read this site id instead of the active one (from list_sites)

tools.name: fleet
tools.description: All your sites in one read: top fix or biggest leak per site, plus patterns that repeat across sites. Free.

tools.name: mark_fix_applied
tools.description: Record that a fix for a finding shipped, so check_fix can compare before and after. Call it once the change is live in production.

fixed_at.description: ISO time the fix went live; defaults to now

tools.name: set_goal
tools.description: Set the one thing this site's visitors should do (book a call, start checkout, sign up). Findings then rank by what they cost it, and fixes are judged by it. Find candidates in the code first (Stripe/checkout links, signup forms, CTA button text) and confirm with the user. Free. The reply carries goal_check {status, matches, suggestions}: the goal is checked at once against real clicks from the last 14 days, else the live page. If status is no_match, the goal will count 0 conversions: do not leave it; pick the right text from suggestions (or the code) and call set_goal again in the same session. If unverified (no click data yet, page may be drawn by JavaScript), confirm the exact button text in the code.

kind.description: click = a click whose text or selector contains match; page = visiting a path (exact, or a prefix ending in *)

matches.description: Button texts exactly as rendered (e.g. ['Book a call', 'BOOK A CALL']) or paths (e.g. ['/thank-you', '/c/*'])

value_usd.description: What one conversion is worth, if the user knows; enables dollar figures

tools.name: upgrade
tools.description: Get a checkout link to upgrade the UserProof plan (Pro $29/mo for 50,000 visits, Scale $99/mo for 250,000; both unlimited sites). Use when the user asks to upgrade or pay. Show the link on its own line.

plan.description: Defaults to the next plan up

tools.name: check_fix
tools.description: Did a shipped fix work? Compares the finding's signal before and after the fix, the share of sessions that go on to a next step (click a control, use a form, open a second page), and conversion, the last two against untouched pages (difference-in-differences). Says 'inconclusive' when traffic is too thin. Free.

finding_id.description: Finding id the fix was recorded for

url.description: Scan defects only: test this base URL instead of the live site, e.g. a local dev server running the fix

tools.name: wait_for_first_event
tools.description: Confirm the UserProof snippet records: waits up to `wait` seconds for the first event from this site and says what arrived (page loads, clicks) and from where (live site, local dev server, or setup check). If nothing arrives it returns the likely cause. Free.

since.description: ISO time to count events from; defaults to 15 minutes ago

tools.name: scan_site
tools.description: Pre-traffic scan of the live site (read-only: no form posts): clicks what looks clickable, checks links and errors, and returns the one worst defect it can reproduce 3 of 3 times. Results are labelled as a scan, not visitor behaviour. Takes 1-3 minutes. Free, 10 a day per site.

url.description: Page to start from; defaults to the site's home page

tools.name: check_coverage
tools.description: Which pages of this site are missing the UserProof snippet, from the sitemap. Free.

fresh.description: Re-run now instead of reusing a check under 6 hours old

tools.name: get_activation
tools.description: Onboarding milestones for this UserProof account and minutes from signup to each, including time to the first verified fix. Free.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: The plan, recorded visits this month against its limit, sites against the site limit, and when the count resets. Free.
